task_name: World 471 Task D  -  Multi-Lever CFO Workforce & Benefits Cost-Reduction Bridge & Hidden Carrier Roster Leak Audit
prompt: Review the CFO_Multi_Lever_Savings schedule in `benadmin_ease_vs_payroll_nov2026.xlsx`. Reconcile biweekly, monthly, and annualized employer payroll and tax savings alongside the EFT wire reduction, compute steady-state employer medical and total annualized run-rate savings excluding one-time carrier credits, and quantify hidden carrier roster leaks requiring executive confirmation.

rubric.description: Computes $22,434.35 per-biweekly-run employer payroll + tax cost reduction ($179,822.69 to $157,388.34, or $48,607.76 monthly / $583,293.10 annualized) and reconciles the $25,446.13 payroll EFT wire reduction ($22,434.35 employer cost reduction + $3,011.78 higher withheld employee deductions).

Computes steady-state monthly employer medical reduction from $44,113.26 ($47,755.71 less $3,642.45 EE) to $9,302.25 ($20,806.71 steady-state less $11,504.46 pre+post-tax EE), saving $34,811.01 monthly ($417,732.12 annualized) plus $5,613.92 dependent Dental/Vision shift = $1,006,639.14 total annualized run-rate savings while excluding the -$8,027.21 one-time retroactive DELSUB credit.

Identifies $674.44 per month ($8,093.28 annualized) of hidden carrier roster items ($544.61 on zero-hour unpaid-leave employee with $0 paycheck deduction + $129.83 on non-payroll Excluded enrollee) requiring explicit CEO confirmation before cancellation.
